title: E-FRC-0063: the sector Koide mechanism predicts Q = 2/3 for any three-generation triple, but only charged leptons...
purpose: Experiment E-FRC-0063 in the gauge arena: the sector Koide mechanism predicts Q = 2/3 for any three-generation triple, but only charged leptons satisfy it sharply (one part in a hundred thousand) while up quarks give 0.85, down quarks 0.73, and the heavy (c, b, t) triple 0.669 (the known near-Koide triple, mixed-scheme masses), so the mechanism is lepton-specific or incomplete, the honest scope limit of the campaign and a falsifiable handle.
known_limitations: Depth L1 (L1: known mathematics, correctly confirmed).
